pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area is significantly larger on the upper flank and neck, becoming increasingly fragmented and smaller towards the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light buff-colored pathways. Junction nodes are clearly defined with higher spatial frequency on the mid-flank where the inter-patch thickness narrows to approximately 5-10 pixels.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the cervical-dorsal transition characterized by a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette of dark hair fibers.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, horizontal, linear indentation or mark is visible on the lower mid-flank, causing a localized disruption in the pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Notable gradient of patch reduction where large, dark brown dorsal blocks transition into small, high-density stippled markings near the hindquarters.
